correctness.rationale: Contraction in spectral radius gives square-summable independent Brownian-Exponential increments; backward Poisson construction plus synchronous contraction proves a unique stationary law. The scalar Fourier product has exactly m(v) positive Laplace factors when (A^T)^m v first vanishes; Fourier inversion gives \(C^{2m-2}\); the product differential equation gives a nonzero \((2m-1)\)-st derivative jump of (-1)^m/prod a_j. If A is invertible, every finite group of factors bounds the joint Fourier transform by arbitrary inverse powers; if singular, the invariant Fokker-Planck identity has a nonzero singular source A#mu, ruling out globally \(C^2\) density. Exact-rational checks were run from included verify.py; proof establishes all dimensions.

value.rationale: For anisotropic linear reset dynamics, the length of the zero-eigenvalue generalized Jordan chain determines an exact finite differentiability order and nonzero jump amplitude of an observable projection, while non-killed projections are infinitely smooth. This is an exact natural classification, with a global all-dimensional invertible-versus-singular regularity boundary despite elliptic Brownian noise; it adds qualitative and quantitative information beyond existing scalar cases or general moment formulas.
